'''A New Companion''' is an interlude in [[Chapter I]] of the [[Main Quests]].

==Steps==
*Head to Panhua's Restaurant and talk to your friends

==Dialogue ==
{{Quest Description|After the battle of Norfall Barren, everything came to an end. Your friends are calling you for a meet-up with snacks at Panhua's Restaurant. It seems they like to know more about that "little one" from within your body...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_1_1.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Over here! Been waiting for ya!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_1_2.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' I thought [[Yangyang]] said you had a super cool lil' buddy to show us. Where is it?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_1_3_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_1_3_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' Uh, I don't know...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_1_4.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Did it just... pop out of your [[Tacet Mark]]...?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_1_5.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' Mmm... smells good!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_1_6.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' So... Is this how it first showed up when you guys were in the [[Norfall Barrens]]?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_1_7.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Yes, back then, we...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_1_8.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' As I fought off those [[Tacet Discord]]s, a burst of energy erupted from that statue...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_1_9.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Two forces clashed and collided, and later one of them emerged victorious, vanquishing the other in a violent clash.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_1_10.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' General [[Jiyan]] and Rover later told me it was this little thing coming out of Rover's body. It was blocking, or even "consuming" the overflow of Threnodian power.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_1_11_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_1_11_F.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' It reminded me of how Rover once absorbed frequency energy with {{MC|m=his|f=her}} body in a similar fashion. So we took {{MC|m=him|f=her}} to the [[Huaxu Academy|Academy]] for a check-up with [[Baizhi]].
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_1_12.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Apparently... this little one is what we had detected before. It’s the speculated "Space" or "Organism" hidden inside your body. Now we finally know.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_1_13.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' It shares similar frequencies with Tacet Discords' [[Reverberation]]s. It resembles an [[Echo]] processed by the [[Data Bank]], stored inside your body instead of a Terminal.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_1_14.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' In other words, it's your own Echo, captured or absorbed at some point. Without you, it can't manifest.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_1_15.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' That's why Baizhi couldn't confirm just how you absorbed that Echo back then. Was it you? Was it the little one? Or maybe, the two of you together?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_1_16.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' And Baizhi discovered more after analyzing your spectrums.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_1_17.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' She found a new power source within you, similar to the [[Crownless]] but even stronger. This power comes from the Tacet Discord you defeated in Norfall Barrens.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_1_18.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' So, the excess energy this little thing had "consumed" somehow ended up in your body, available at your disposal. In other words, there's a deeper connection between the two of you. Or, according to Baizhi, it’s a Convergent Codependency.
:{{DIcon}} Convergent Codependency?
:{{DIcon}} That's new. What does that mean?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_1_21.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Uh, to put it simply... you are connected. While you are two separate individuals, your energies and vitals can affect each other, for better or for worse. You may even feel each other's emotions.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_1_22.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' The bond between you and this creature is symbiotic. As it strengthens, so do you. However, if one is harmed, the other suffers.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_1_23.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Fortunately, since it can't ever leave your side, it's not an easy target for attackers. And if they do strike, it can seek shelter inside your body for safety.
:{{DIcon}} I... think I understand.
:{{DIcon}} Sounds complicated. Let's talk about it later.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_1_26.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Okay, now that's... pretty much it. Baizhi was going to explain it to you herself, but she has to go check on a newly appeared [[Sonoro Sphere]] in [[Zhaozhou]]...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_1_27.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Wait, wait! This is too much information for me to process! Let me get this straight. So, it helped Rover fight off the [[Threnodian]]?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_1_28.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Seriously? This teeny tiny thing could do that? Hmm. Seems unlikely...
----
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_1_29.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' Hmph! Don't look down on me.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_1.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' You'll regret it when you learn what I'm capable of!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_2.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' That poker-faced researcher was absolutely shocked when she examined me! Said I'm not just any Echo, I'm a super duper cool one. Rarest of them all! Heh heh!
:{{DIcon}} You sure you didn't add anything extra?
:{{DIcon}} That doesn't sound like the Baizhi I know...
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_5.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Yeah, no way Baizhi talks like that. She's more of a data dump kind of person. "Super duper cool"? Nah, too extra for her.
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_6.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Seems like you're trying to boost your ego a bit!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_7.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Oh, actually... While those aren't Baizhi's exact words, that is what she meant.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_8.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' She mentioned highly intelligent Echoes that can act on their own in other countries. Said they are involved in every aspect of human life, with unique abilities beyond our imagination.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_9.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Those Echoes are rare though. Neither I nor Baizhi, an Ecoacoustics expert, have ever seen one in person. But this little thing here... It could be one of those foreign Echoes.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_10.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Yeah, makes sense! Now we just gotta figure out where it came from. Who knows, we may find other cool Echoes in that place!
:{{DIcon}} Are you seriously buying all of this already?
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_14.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Well, both General Jiyan and Baizhi have confirmed it. No way they're lying.
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_15.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' I'll admit, the thought of someone else having an Echo inside them sounds pretty crazy to me. But with you, anything's possible.
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_16.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' You can absorb Reverberations with just your hands, like the legend says. So maybe one day you just stumbled upon this little thing and soaked it up like a sponge. Sounds feasible, I guess?
:{{DIcon|Arrow}} Sure, sounds doable.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_17.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Sooo...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_18_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_18_F.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Do you know where exactly {{MC|m=he|f=she}} absorbed you?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_19_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_19_F.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' Huh? How am I supposed to know... Why don't you just ask {{MC|m=him|f=her}}?
:{{DIcon}} Because they know I don't remember.
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_22_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_22_F.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Yeah. It happened before {{MC|m=he|f=she}} lost all memories, so we have to ask you.
:{{DIcon}} Sure, she can ask. It's not like I have the answer.
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_23.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' Tsk tsk... Don't take that tone with me.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_24.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' But... even if Echoes can have memories, they probably wouldn’t remember things earlier than their first manifestation. I wonder if that's the case with this little one, too?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_25.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' Aha, finally someone with common sense.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_26.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' That green-haired serious guy asked me a similar question. Sorry to disappoint, but I really don't remember anything before I showed up.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_27_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_27_F.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' Hmm. Maybe... maybe I was just sleeping inside {{MC|m=him|f=her}} this whole time, so of course I don't remember!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_28.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Sleeping? Seriously? It's been so long! All those happenings, all that fighting, and you didn't hear anything? Well that's... Your sleeping quality is really something.
:{{DIcon}} I'd prefer it to NOT stay awake all the time.
:{{DIcon}} Uh, please no. There are things I don't want it to hear...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_31.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' Oh, so you've got privacy to be respected.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_32.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' Don't worry! Your body's sound insulation is amazing. Dive into it and everything goes quiet.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_33.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' The only problem is, I never know when I'll wake up again. And when I do wake up, I get tired, hungry fast, so I have to crawl back in for more rest.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_34.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' Hmm... I know! It's all because I'm not eating enough!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_35.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' That's why you kept disappearing. You went back to sleep from lack of energy. Makes sense. Regular Echoes need to be powered by the Terminal too.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_36.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Hmm, I thought you'd be really different from the usual ones we see. Turns out you share a lot in common.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_37.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' So you probably don't know your denomination, or a nick name? No wonder everyone's been calling you the "little one"...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_38.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' Denomination? What's that?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_39.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' The universally agreed terms for special Echoes, like names for humans. They are named based on their characteristics, abilities, and places of origin.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_40.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' My denomination... It's... It's... I don't know. Do I not have a name at all?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_41.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' No way! Nooo way! That's not fair! If all the special Echoes have names, how can I not have one?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_42.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' I don't wanna be called the "little one" all the time. It doesn't sound cool at all!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_43.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' How about this: you help me come up with a name, and I will let you have some of the food...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_2_44.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' There's nothing left...
----
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_1.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' Erm... Next time! Next time I'll definitely save some for you! Just... give me a name! Please!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_2.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' A name? Now?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_3.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' Yes, I want it now! Look, your name's Chixia, your name's Yangyang, and you... Uhhh, your name is...
:{{DIcon}} {{Rover}}.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_5.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' {{Rover}}? ...That sounds interesting. Wait, didn't you forget everything? How do you still remember...
:{{DIcon}} I just came up with it. It's my new name now.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_7.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' With your old name and memories all gone, it's a good idea to go with a new one. It makes everything more convenient and represents a fresh start.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_8.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' Yeah, exactly like she said! Every one of you has a name, and I want one for myself too! Really not asking much.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_9.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' I just want a name that sounds a little cool, a little special and epic and super smokin'!
:{{DIcon}} That's a long list of descriptors...
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_12.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' Names are a big deal, you know? Like, once you have one, it's stuck with you for life. Gotta make sure it's a good one!
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_13.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' Can't have people not scared of me when they hear it. No time for regrets here!
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, you having a name should make things easier.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_14.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' That's true.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_15.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Let's see... You want a cool one... What about "Echo the Invincible"? What do you say?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_16.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' Nah, nuh-uh, absolutely no! That's too straightforward. It's-It's no better than calling me the "little one"!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_17.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Hey, it makes every difference in the world! "I am Echo the Invincible!" That's what a Hero Play character would say as their transformation call!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_18.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Or maybe... Since you can fly and you've got those long ears... why don’t you call yourself... "Righteous Raptor"? Or "Valor Hawk"? "Flying Fury"?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_19.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' No, absolutely no. Why do they all sound so... cringy...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_20.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Why? I love it when people call me the Jinzhou Speedster. Doesn't that sound awesome?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_21.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' Uh... Haha, sure, if you say so... Anyway, they all sound like anything but my name. ABSOLUTELY NO!
:{{DIcon}} Absolutely no this, absolutely no that. What do you want?
::{{DIcon}} Let’s make it simple. Why don't you just call yourself Abby.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_24.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' Aha! I knew {{Rover}} would come up with a good... Wait. Why does it sound so random?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_25.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' You didn't just pick two random syllables, did you?
:{{DIcon}} Why not? Simplicity works wonders.
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_28.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' I mean... Yeah, it's simple, easy to remember. l can imagine myself yelling it out loud, and at least it sounds better than Chixia’s cringy titles... But you know, it doesn’t feel quite majestic enough...
:{{DIcon}} Abby means joy. It's what you bring to us.
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_29.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' So... Is it because I've been saying "Absolutely no" a lot...?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_30.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' ...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_31.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' ...
:{{DIcon}} (Why, isn't that a nice name..)
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_34_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_34_F.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' (Hmm... Why is it suddenly so quiet? Is it not happy with the name? Why though... Can't think of anything better that's catchy, impactful, and clever all at once.)
:{{DIcon}} (Maybe I should come up with a better one...)
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_35_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_35_F.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' (Uh, I meant to tease it as a joke, but I can tell it's upset now. On second thought, a name is indeed very important. Maybe I'll have to come up with a different one...)
::{{DIcon}} Let’s just think of another...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_37.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' Hmm... Abby... Abra... Abraxas?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_38.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' What's wrong? What are you muttering about? Abra... what? Sounds like you're reading a spell.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_39.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' ...Erm, I don't know, but... I just have this feeling that... this is what my name should be. Okay, ready?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_40.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' Abby! I like the sound of that. That's my name!
:{{DIcon}} I thought you didn't like it.
:{{DIcon}} Good. Saves us time thinking of another one.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_43.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' Of course I like it! You came up with it for me! I was just... trying to get used to it, that's all! Besides, I feel attached to this name now.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_44.ogg}} '''"Little One":''' My name is Abby. You will NOT call me the "little one" again!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_45.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Sure, we won't. Got it.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_46.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Well, that didn't work out. I was hoping we could get some answers from the little... I mean, from Abby, but now we're back at square one.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_47.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' I really thought we could figure out where Abby came from. It might not lead us to other special Echoes, but it's at least a starting point to uncover {{Rover}}'s past. Then we'll have something to do before asking Madam [[Jinhsi|Magistrate]] and our [[Jué|Sentinel]] about it again.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_48.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Maybe we can start with Abby's special abilities instead?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_49.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Each special Echo has a unique ability. We can compare what Abby does with our records of other Echoes to see where they came from. Besides... It was Abby’s power that helped {{Rover}} defeat the Threnodian, I suppose?
:{{DIcon}} Likely so.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_51.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Why do you sound so unsure? Didn't you see it all with your own eyes?
:{{DIcon}} It happened too fast. I didn't get a clear look.
:{{DIcon}} I'd be more sure if I can see it again.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_54.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Hmm... Abby, can you show us again? I'm super curious how you did that. Who knows, we might learn something.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_3_55.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Well, since you asked, I'll show you how it's done! But... this place is too crowded. Let's move to that open spot over there.
----
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_4_1.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Alright. Ahem! All eyes on me!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_4_2.ogg}} '''Abby:''' W-what's going on? I... I'll try again! Just you see!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_4_3.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Uh... What? Did something happen?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_4_4.ogg}} '''Abby:''' J-Just a little slip, that's all! I can do it! You gotta trust me!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_4_5_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_4_5_F.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Back then, I just stood in front of {{MC|m=him|f=her}}, and that big bad Threnodian monster thing just... just... left.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_4_6.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' So... you didn't really do anything?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_4_7.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Huh? No, I... I definitely did something!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_4_8.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Like I said, I was asleep, and then all of a sudden, I smelled something really yummy coming closer and closer... It was like nothing I ever smelled before!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_4_9.ogg}} '''Abby:''' I didn't have time to think. I just had to show up and reach out for it.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_4_10.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' So... maybe Abby's power activates automatically under certain circumstances? Perhaps Abby can’t control it yet.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_4_11.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Yeah, it looks that way. You can't even hold your shape for very long yet...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_4_12.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Hey, hey! Stop looking down on me! Like I said, it was just a little slip, really!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_4_13.ogg}} '''Abby:''' But think about it! I just stood there and did nothing and ended up beating a THRENODIAN! Imagine what I could do if I actually tried!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_4_14.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Hey, {{Rover}}! Get behind me next time we run into anything, 'kay? I'll keep you safe, promise!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_4_15.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' You're so real for that, Abby.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_4_16_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_4_16_F.ogg}} '''Abby:''' You bet! I said I'm super strong. I'll protect {{MC|m=him|f=her}}!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_4_17.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' That's very reassuring to hear. But... it seems we're stuck again. I can't think of anything else to check out.
:{{DIcon}} Let’s take our time. There's no hurry.
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_4_20.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Knew it. Nothing about {{Rover}}'s ever gonna be easy to figure out... Hmm. Maybe we should bring Baizhi, Mr. [[Xiangli Yao]], and all the researchers in [[Jinzhou]]... No, in the entire [[Huanglong]] together. They'll do a nice and thorough examination on Abby, and then...
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_4_21.ogg}} '''Abby:''' ABSOLUTELY NO!
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_4_22.ogg}} '''Abby:''' I said NO! Told that poker-face researcher already!
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_4_23.ogg}} '''Abby:''' I'll make it clear. I am to stay with {{Rover}}.
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_4_24_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_4_24_F.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' I agree. Abby cannot leave {{Rover}}'s side, but we can't just trap {{MC|m=him|f=her}} here for research.
:{{DIcon|Arrow}} We'll still need to figure out my past first.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_4_25.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Where did you absorb Abby, what are Abby's powers, and what exactly happened between you two... There are so many questions we can't figure out yet.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_4_26.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Our Sentinel Jué can look into the future. Nothing ever deviates from its predictions. It has already sort of guided you to the Norfall Barrens through Madam Magistrate's messages, right?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_4_27.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Now that the Threnodian crisis is over, perhaps you can consult our Magistrate and our Sentinel again. I’m sure they can offer you some more useful guidance.
:{{DIcon}} I'll pay Jinhsi another visit once she returns.
:{{DIcon}} We'll have to wait for now.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_4_30.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Relax, relax! You have me now, remember? Meeting up with that Jinhsi person? Getting your memories back? I've got you!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_1_4_31.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Speaking of that, so this Sentinel can predict the future? That sounds cool. The name "Jué" sounds pretty cool too. It's almost as cool as mine!
